page.content:
Hasbro ponies from G1 toys through Friendship Is Magic, Equestria, and the Mane Six.

How My Little Pony connects

  • Faction: Hasbro — Hasbro owns My Little Pony and commissions its toy-and-TV eras.
  • Series: My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic — Friendship Is Magic is the flagship modern series of My Little Pony.
  • Work: My Little Pony (G1) — Generation 1 is the original toy-and-cartoon age of My Little Pony.
  • Work: My Little Pony: A New Generation — A New Generation opens the Generation 5 chapter of My Little Pony.
  • Concept: Cutie mark — Cutie marks are the talent-symbols of the My Little Pony world.

What is My Little Pony?

My Little Pony is Hasbro's horse-toy franchise that Bonnie Zacherle launched in the 1980s and Lauren Faust remade as Friendship Is Magic: Twilight Sparkle, the Mane Six, Princess Celestia, and a map of Equestria that the later films still inherit.

Key threads lead to Hasbro, My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic, My Little Pony (G1), My Little Pony: A New Generation and Cutie mark.
